name: Ducati ST2 / ST3 / ST4
engine: 944 to 996 cc L-twin, air/liquid cooled, fuel injected
intro: Ducati's sport tourers. Fuel injected, desmo valves, timing belts and hard bags.

H: Desmo valve service needs both opening and closing shims checked. Follow the interval in the manual; it is not a job to skip.
Ducati timing belts are changed by time as well as miles. If you can't prove when they were done, do them before riding.

recallNote: Ducati has issued recalls on some bikes in these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
